tagline: Let's set up your plan. Your answers stay on this device.
resumed: Picked up where you left off.

about.title: About you
about.description: A few basics so we can tailor the plan.

body.title: Your body
body.description: Used for calorie and protein targets. You can update your weight any time.

goal.title: Your goal
goal.description: What you want to achieve and by when.

experience.title: Training experience
experience.description: How much strength or fitness training have you done before?

health.title: Injuries and health
health.description: We use this to pick safer exercises. Tick anything that applies.

lifestyle.title: Lifestyle
lifestyle.description: Be honest, there are no wrong answers.

plan.title: Choose your plan
plan.description: We recommend a level from your answers. You can pick another.

about.name: Your name
about.sexHint: Only used to estimate your calorie needs.

goal.targetHint: Your plan runs until this date.

beginner.label: Beginner
beginner.hint: New to training, or back after a long break

intermediate.label: Intermediate
intermediate.hint: Trained regularly for 6 months or more

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.hint: Several years of consistent, structured training

health.injuriesHint: Leave empty if nothing bothers you.
health.parqHint: Tick any that apply to you.

parqQuestions.heart: A doctor has said I have a heart condition or high blood pressure
parqQuestions.chestPain: I get chest pain at rest, in daily life or when active
parqQuestions.dizziness: In the last 12 months I've lost balance from dizziness or lost consciousness
parqQuestions.chronic: I have another long-term medical condition
parqQuestions.medication: I take prescribed medication for a long-term condition
parqQuestions.joint: I have a bone, joint or muscle problem that activity could make worse
parqQuestions.supervised: A doctor has said I should only exercise under medical supervision

health.doctorTitle: Please check with a doctor first
health.doctorBody: Based on your answers, talk to a doctor before starting a new exercise plan. FitPower is not medical advice.
health.cleared: A doctor has cleared me to exercise

lifestyle.diet: How would you rate your diet?
lifestyle.health: How would you rate your overall health?
lifestyle.equipmentHint: A pair of dumbbells and a resistance band is all you need for a full home program.

easy.label: Easy
easy.hint: Fewer rounds and longer rests. Great for starting out or coming back.

intermediate.label: Intermediate
intermediate.hint: The balanced program: steady progress with full-body sessions.

hard.label: Hard
hard.hint: More rounds and shorter rests for experienced trainees.

plan.aiBody: Connect your own AI key and a coach will interview you and design the plan.
plan.aiOffBody: The built-in plans work fully offline. You can redesign your plan with an AI coach later.
plan.saveError: Couldn't save your plan. Please try again.
plan.restartNotice: This restarts your program: day 1 becomes {{date}}. Your logged workouts, weights and photos are kept.
plan.continueNotice: Your program keeps its start date ({{date}}), so your day count and streak carry on.

errors.age: You need to be between 13 and 100 years old
errors.height: Enter a height between 100 and 250 cm
errors.weight: Enter a weight between 30 and 300 kg
errors.goalWeight: Enter a goal weight between 30 and 300 kg
errors.startDate: Pick a start date no more than 60 days ahead
errors.targetDate: Pick a target date between 4 weeks and 2 years after the start
errors.targetPast: Pick a target date after today
